messages:
marta.g: Running a negative-control for prefetch/speculative path. Speculative decoder disabled but KV warmup kept, so we measure prefilling effects in isolation. Planning: quick bench (1k long prompts) then a larger quality sweep if nothing obvious. Please sanity-check config and abort criteria. :eyes:

samir: What's the exact run command/config? paste it here so infra can replicate.

marta.g: Sure, quick copy of the script we used:

```
python run_bench.py \
  --model ll-13b-quant \
  --speculative false \
  --kv-warmup true \
  --batch-size 8 \
  --seed 42 \
  --eval-set longform_1k.json \
  --log-prefix pref-negctl-1772468
```

nyla: Add deterministic flags for the control run: `--seed 42 --deterministic` so sampling variance is minimal. Also include token-level traces for first 200 tokens.

eli: I can stand up the bench. ETA ~2h including data prep. Ops: do we need a special quota?

ops-bot: Deploy queued: bench-job/1772468 -> queued on cluster-ml-us-east, expected start in 15m.

samir: Reminder: capture KV hit/miss counters, prefix cache reuse, and latency histograms (p50/p95/p99). If hallucination delta > 1.5% vs baseline, abort and tag for triage.

marta.g: Good point. We'll record: kv_miss_ratio, forward_time/token, cache_reuse_pct, and halluc_rate. Also capturing raw outputs for BLEU/ROUGE/KL.

nyla: Plotting plan: (1) token-level KL over first 200 tokens, (2) prefix-accuracy vs baseline, (3) hallucination per prompt length bucket. I'll push a quick viz script to the experiment dir.

eli: Bench finished. Quick raw numbers (1k long prompts):
- baseline (speculative on): p50 72ms, p95 190ms, halluc_rate 4.1%
- neg-control (speculative off, kv-warmup on): p50 78ms, p95 210ms, halluc_rate 5.0%
- kv_miss_ratio: baseline 3.2%, neg-control 2.9%

marta.g: Huh — latency increase ~8% p50, p95 +~10%, halluc delta +0.9%. KV miss ratio slightly down, so warmup seems working but we lost some latency benefits from speculation. Not catastrophic but notable.

samir: That halluc delta is borderline. Next step: run quality-only sweep (10k prompts) with same control to get confidence intervals. Also run exact-match and BLEU for the dataset.

nyla: K, kicking off quality sweep now. I'll run with `--save-outputs` and aggregate metrics. Expect ~6-8h. I'll upload artifacts to GCS when done.

marta.g: If the larger sweep keeps halluc delta <=1%, we'll include this neg-control as a comparator in the spec doc for prefetch experiments. If >1%, we'll investigate KV heuristics and early-prefetch thresholds.

eli: Also flag to ops: add one more run toggling `kv-warmup=false` (pure no-prefetch) so we have three arms: speculative-on, kv-warmup-only, neither. That helps isolate where latency/quality tradeoffs appear.

ops-bot: Job queued: bench-job/1772469 (no-prefetch arm) -> queued on cluster-ml-us-east.

marta.g: Nice. I'll update the experiment note with links and a brief checklist: 1) replicate commands, 2) collect histograms + traces, 3) run 10k quality sweep, 4) compare KL/bleu/hallucination buckets, 5) escalate if >1.5% regression.

samir: One more ask: keep raw logits for 200 examples so we can compute per-token uncertainty and see if prefetch changes entropy patterns.

nyla: Will do. I'll also add a short notebook that computes bootstrap CI for halluc_rate.

marta.g: Thanks all — I'll draft the results summary for the spec doc once the 10k sweep completes. tl;dr so far: prefetch-only control increases latency modestly vs speculative path and has small +0.9% hallucation; need more data to decide. :memo:
